title: Chunk map file and preload manifest
answers: How does the preload manifest get produced and consumed?
How does the backend emit modulepreload tags?
body:
- chunkLoader.mjs: `chunkMapFileName(entry, chunks)` → `chunk-map-<entry>-<8hex sha256>.js` (hash over exact emitted bytes). Full map served as separate immutable static file setting `window.ESBUILD_CHUNK_MAP`; only the `index` list is inline in HTML. `ESBUILD_LOAD_CHUNKS(name)` loads `chunk-<hash>.js` not in ESBUILD_LOADED_CHUNKS; scenes requested before the map arrives queue in ESBUILD_PENDING_CHUNK_SCENES. Map is prefetch-only optimization.
- frontend/build.mjs:`writePreloadManifest` writes dist/preload-manifest.json: css, font, js (entry + chunks >= PRELOAD_MIN_CHUNK_BYTES 50KB from index.tsx and App.tsx), authenticatedJs (AuthenticatedShell.tsx). Throws if a field is empty.
- posthog/utils.py:`_resolve_entry_assets(include_authenticated_shell)` reads that manifest from BASE_DIR/frontend/dist (cached per process; empty in debug/test or if missing) → context preload_css_url/preload_js_urls/preload_font_url, set only when template_name == "index.html".
- frontend/src/index.html renders them as <link rel=preload/modulepreload href="{{ js_url }}/{{ ... }}">.
